name: default
_comment: Section order of the formatted reading for clinical pages (document_formatter.py). Replace with the hospital's own format via OCR_FORMAT_TEMPLATE=<path>. Each section: key (fixed ids: patient, rx and labs are filled from the structured extraction; any other key is free text), title as printed (null prints no title), headings doctors write for it (matched at the start of a line, case-insensitive), keep_unpunctuated: keep a heading word in the text unless a ':' or '-' follows it ('Review after one week'). unlabelled: where text with no heading goes before the medicines; after_rx: where it goes after them.
